tools.name: classify_ai_system
tools.description: Classifies an AI system into the EU AI Act risk tiers (prohibited, high, limited, minimal) from 9 facts about it. Returns the tier, a compliance score, findings with the legal article, the documents the tier requires, and a link to the saved report. Ask the user for any fact you do not know instead of guessing.

processesBiometric.description: Processes biometric data (face, voice, fingerprint, emotion).

makesConsequentialDecisions.description: Effect on people: binding decisions, influences a human decision, or none.

disclosesAi.description: How users are told it is AI.

euJurisdiction.description: Whether it is offered or its output used in the EU ("spain" if Spain specifically).

hasHumanOversight.description: A person can review and override its output.

hasTechnicalDocs.description: Technical documentation of the system exists.

companyName.description: Optional, shown on the saved report.

tools.name: estimate_ai_act_fine
tools.description: Maximum administrative fine under Articles 99 and 101 of the EU AI Act for a violation type, given worldwide annual turnover, including the lower-of rule for SMEs (Art. 99(6)).

annualTurnoverEur.description: Total worldwide annual turnover in euros.

isSme.description: The company is an SME or start-up.

violation.description: prohibited: Deploying a system that falls under Article 5. obligations: Failing provider, deployer, importer, distributor or transparency duties. information: Supplying incorrect, incomplete or misleading information to notified bodies or authorities. gpai: Fines imposed by the European Commission on providers of general-purpose AI models.

tools.name: generate_ai_disclosure_notice
tools.description: Ready-to-paste "you are interacting with an AI" notices required by Article 50 of the EU AI Act, for chat, voice and AI-generated content, in up to 8 EU languages (en, es, de, fr, it, pt, nl, pl).

assistantName.description: Name of the assistant, if it has one.

generatedContent.description: Publishes AI-generated text, images, audio or video.

hasHumanHandoff.description: Users can be transferred to a human (default true).

tools.name: list_ai_act_deadlines
tools.description: Every application date of the EU AI Act after the 2026 Digital Omnibus (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744): what applies, to whom, the legal basis and how many days are left.

upcomingOnly.description: Only dates that have not passed (default false).
